source.authority: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
source.text: The controller shall communicate any rectification or erasure of personal data or restriction of processing carried out in accordance with Article 16, Article 17(1) and Article 18 to each recipient to whom the personal data have been disclosed, unless this proves impossible or involves disproportionate effort. The controller shall inform the data subject about those recipients if the data subject requests it.

deploymentNotes: At deployment: 'structure' resolves to the data controller (accountable). 'purpose' resolves to the adopter's personal data processing scope. Mandates notification of each recipient when rectification (Art 16), erasure (Art 17(1)), or restriction (Art 18) has been carried out, unless impossible or disproportionate effort. Also requires informing the data subject about recipients on request. Operationalized by Norm checking recipient notification.
